description:
Desktop app for Meta's Muse Code CLI, with threads, inline diffs, approvals and a file viewer.

Helicon is an open-source desktop and web app for Meta's Muse Code CLI. It drives the muse command you already have
over Muse's own session protocol, so Muse stays the agent: your login, your plan, your approvals.
Every project's threads sit in one sidebar and resume in a click, including threads started in the terminal. Edits
arrive as inline diffs, approvals are surfaced rather than batched, and a file viewer beside the thread reads source,
Markdown, images, video and PDFs. It runs Muse natively on Windows, with WSL2 also supported.
Helicon is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with Meta.
